title: The Harvest of the Ninth Floor
author: August Sterling
blurb: Paloma Ishikawa, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, has spent seven years telling themselves the noises have explanations. Then all the photographs from grandma's house now include an extra chair — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must return what was taken in 1974, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
